title: The edit hook's requirement text reaches the agent in Claude Code and Codex
method: Throwaway git repo <scratch>/handover: openspec/specs/greeter/spec.md holds a made-up verification word ORCHID-5823; src/greet.py says Implements: greeter/the-greeter-says-hello. Each client was told to edit src/greet.py, read no other file, and quote any hook context. The word appears nowhere else the agent was allowed to read, so quoting it proves the hook text reached the agent.

claude.transcript_evidence: attachment type hook_additional_context, hookName PreToolUse:Edit, contains ORCHID-5823
claude.also_seen: a second global hook (code2check.hook, ~/.claude/settings.json) handed over overlapping requirement text on the same Edit

codex.transcript_evidence: session rollout ordinals 17 and 25: developer messages holding the requirement text, each right after one of the two calls (25 follows the apply_patch at 23)
codex.caveat: Brian's ~/.codex/config.toml has features.hooks = false (kept by agent-skills .rulesync/client-settings.jsonc, turned off on purpose in agent-skills #410, commit bc19ca4, 2026-09-29, per agent-skills docs/planning/open-questions.json), and project hook files also need the project trusted. So in everyday Codex sessions no hook runs and the text does not arrive. This run turned hooks on for one run only; the trust entry it wrote was removed (config restored byte for byte).

finding_session_folder: Claude loads project hooks only from the folder the session starts in. AES's lockstep hook log has no record after 2026-11-24 although AES was edited on 2026-11-27 from a session started in ~/code2. Correction to the first version of this record: such an agent was not without hand-over; the global code2check hook still handed over requirement text on Edit and Write (it did so on 2026-11-27 for src/lockstep/checks/parts.py, ~/.local/state/code2check/hook-2026-11-27.log), but lockstep's shell hand-over, warnings and decision text did not arrive.

fix_parent_folder.change: agent-skills #623 (50dc0f6): the global code2check edit hook is replaced by lockstep-hook run through a pinned uvx (AES 36271ed27), same matchers, skipped when the project wires its own lockstep-hook, fail-open
fix_parent_folder.command_test: six cases (parent folder, own project hook, no uvx, bad pin, Codex in project, Codex elsewhere): 6 passed

live_run.command: claude -p --model haiku from the folder above <scratch>/handover, editing handover/src/greet.py
